hints.title: Minimum Element Extraction
hints.text: Find the smallest value across the given integer array. Then extract its base-10 digits to calculate their sum.

hints.title: Digit Summation
hints.text: While the minimum value is greater than zero, peel off the last digit via modulo 10 and add it to the running sum.

hints.title: Parity Result Mapping
hints.text: If the total digit sum is odd, return 0. If the total digit sum is even, return 1.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of elements in nums array
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Converting numbers to strings unnecessarily allocates temporary objects.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Finding the minimum and taking modulo digit sum executes in single-pass O(N) time with O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should find the minimum and compute its digit sum using arithmetic division and modulo.
